The Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine mourns the Director-General of the Internal Security Apparatus in the Gaza Strip, Colonel Naeem Muhammad Abu Nahal, who was assassinated by the occupation in an airstrike west of Gaza City yesterday, and Colonel Muhammad Majid Abu al-Ouf, Director of the Internal Security Apparatus in the northern Gaza Governorate, who was martyred along with his wife and two daughters in the shelling of a residential apartment this morning. The Popular Front extends its deepest condolences to the families of the martyrs who are falling as a result of the ongoing Zionist aggression on the Gaza Strip, and the airstrikes that target the foundations of life and impose a continuous cycle of killing and depletion of the Palestinian national infrastructure. The Front warns that the occupation's strategy is based on the systematic depletion and destruction of the Strip's capabilities and national institutions, in order to push it towards complete chaos and create an environment that is unsustainable, while simultaneously continuing to obstruct the humanitarian protocol and hinder aid. The Popular Front calls for an urgent stance regarding the silence of the Peace Council, which it considers complicity that provides a cover for the continuation of the war of extermination and ethnic cleansing plans. It emphasizes that this requires a comprehensive review of the mechanisms for implementing the ceasefire agreement and its guarantees, to prevent it from becoming a cover that the occupation and its government exploit to achieve their war aims and export their political crises at the expense of the blood and suffering of the Palestinian people.
